verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Cast all your cares on me
'Cause I care for you, I care for you

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
All your fountains are in Me
I have everything you need
Just keep coming back to Me
Those who call upon My name
They will not be put to shame
Just keep coming back to Me

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
So come to Me if you're weary
And I'll give you rest, I'll give you rest
My yoke is so easy
And My burden is less, My burden is less

verse.name: c2
verse.lines:
All my fountains are in You, You have everything I need
I'll just keep coming back to You
When I call upon Your name I will not be put to shame
I'll just keep coming back to You
